settings.heading: Order questions
settings.text: Have your order number handy for the fastest reply.

settings.heading: Talk to a real person
settings.text: Questions about sizing, shipping or which grinder suits a nervous dog? Send us a note — we answer every message within 24 hours.

settings.question: Where is my order?
settings.answer: You'll get a tracking link by email the moment your parcel ships. If it hasn't moved in 48 hours, reply to that email and we'll chase it.

settings.question: Can I change my address?
settings.answer: Yes, if the order hasn't shipped. Email us your order number and the corrected address as soon as you can.
